'''Gauron Nas Tal''' was a snarling [[Saurin]] [[combat trainer]] who worked for the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. Despite this, the trainer aimed to hunt down its employer by [[4 ABY]]. Having accompanied him to the [[Great Pit of Carkoon]] for the [[Death penalty|execution]] of several [[prisoner]]s, the Saurin was present for the [[Rescue of Han Solo|shootout]] aboard Jabba's [[sail barge]], the ''[[Khetanna]]''. Guaron Nas Tal did not have a chance to take action against his quarry by the [[Death|downfall]] of both the Hutt and the ''Khetanna'' at the battle's end.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Biography==
Gauron Nas Tal was a snarling [[Saurin]] combat trainer who worked for the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], but planned to [[Death|kill]] him.<ref name="AEYNTK" /> In [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of {{Film|VI}} to [[4 ABY]].</ref> Nas Tal stood just outside the doorway to the [[throne]] room of [[Boba Fett's Palace|Jabba's Palace]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] and lent in to listen as the [[droid]]s [[R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO]] played a [[hologram]] of their master, the [[Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker]], for the crime lord. In the message, Skywalker stated that he wished to bargain for the freedom of his friend [[Han Solo]], whom Jabba held as a captive frozen in [[carbonite]], and gifted Jabba the two droids as a sign of good will. The Hutt, however, declared that he had no interest in losing Solo and sent the droids to work.<ref name="ROTJ" />

Nas Tal later sat beside the [[Ugnaught]] [[Yoxgit]] in one of the throne room's booths when the [[Max Rebo Band]] performed the [[Music|song]] "[[Jedi Rocks]]" for the court. After the band finished the song, Jabba demanded it be repeated, but during the second performance he tried to pull the [[Slavery|enslaved]] dancer [[Oola]] closer to him. When she resisted him, the Hutt dropped her into the pit beneath the throne room, halting the band's performance. The Saurin rushed from his seat to a grating looking down into the pit, gleefully gesturing along with other cheering courtiers at the fate of the dancer. As they watched, Jabba's pet [[rancor]], [[Pateesa]], emerged and devoured the screaming Oola.<ref name="ROTJ" />

Nas Tal was present in the throne room when Skywalker arrived at the palace and [[mind trick]]ed [[Bib Fortuna]] in to bringing him to Jabba and waking the crime lord. Members of the court awoke as Skywalker demanded that Jabba release Solo and Chewbacca. Skywalker then threatened Jabba with a [[DL-18 blaster pistol|blaster pistol]], causing the Hutt to drop the Jedi into the rancor pit, along with the unlucky [[Gamorrean]] [[Security guard|guard]] [[Jubnuk]]. After Pateesa ate Jubnuk, the Jedi killed the rancor. Along with Chewbacca and Solo, Skywalker was brought back up to the throne room, for Jabba to sentence them to execution.<ref name="ROTJ" />
